summary: CPUOffloadingSpec/OffloadingSpecFactory missing: kv-offload has no interfaces, so nothing computes cpu_page_size_per_worker, aligned kv_bytes_per_chunk or num_chunks (spec.py:93-126).
EncoderCacheManager missing; scheduler.reset-encoder-cache is a constant {reset:true} and clears no encoder-cache state.
Hybrid/Mamba cache hits are block-grid only; no partial hash hits, EAGLE hash-unit drop or shared-prefix junction checkpoint, so the model returns 0 where code returns 12.
